summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 18, 2026, detailing equity changes. The company issued 28,800 and 91,200 Class A shares on option exercises at USD 2.2051 and USD 4.776, settled 2,992,890 restricted share units, repurchased and cancelled 12,618,812 shares at an average USD 6.7737 between May 27 and June 30, 2026, and cancelled them September 17, 2026, with closing issued shares of 818,267,829. No board recommendation or advisor named; watch buyback pace and WVR conversion overhang.
